question: Start ideation on a gate that a second surface can read and decide safely (group A items 1-5)?

artifacts.summary: Group A of the 2026-11-24 friction list, checked against origin/main a85a26a35. A chat decision binds to whatever attempt is current (no expected briefing id or digest); gate read --json returns only the gates block (no entity path and status, attempt states, current attempt, room); the rendered gate review is not stored with the gate (--summary has no length limit, but nothing holds the presentation); a captain Resolution has no origin field; a gate presentation can miss the captain's chat when another agent starts the turn. Ideation designs one change set and brings it to CL at the ideation gate.
